title: mine lasted 3 months
text: mine lasted 3 months. Unless there is a reset button I haven't found yet mine lasted 3 months in a 300ft space running in c/o mode we emptied the cup everyday. Mine will turn on but none of the touch control do anything. I should have known a Dehumidifiers this cheap was asking for it.
